scope: HuC6280 Synth MSM5205 basic authored sample UI shared with Code
behavior: MSM5205 tab imports WAV or high-nibble-first packed ADPCM from Files. Candidate file selection and waveform preparation never create an AudioContext. Original files, HuC instrument and Code editor/mode are preserved.

WAV conversion reuses the bounded shared PCM-to-ADPCM encoder. One authored sample fits 1..65536 encoded bytes; malformed, oversized, cancelled and superseded loads retain the previous sample. Odd WAV frame count remains distinct from packed padding.

The actual shared offline WASM decoder renders bounded chunks at32kHz into at most512 min/max waveform bins. No full decoded PCM, second speaker route or approximate independent ADPCM decoder is introduced.

Play/Replay, Stop, Loop, numeric Rate0..15 plus effectiveHz, capacity and duration controls use the existing source. Rate/Loop affect the next Play; they do not falsely claim live parameter setters. Stepper clicks, drag and arrow/Home/End keys avoid numeric text-entry focus conflicts.

One authored MSM5205 source/RAM is shared by UI and revocable Code leases on the existing Synth context, per-source Mixer, Code FX/fade and Master. UI Play/Stop/load does not stop HuC Code loops. Code loadSample/loadMemory changes the shown sample; Code.play without arguments uses the UI next-Play defaults.

Code Stop cancels Code-origin loads and leases while retaining the authored sample and valid independent UI imports. UI can replay it; new Run receives a fresh guarded lease of the same source. Global Stop cancels UI work too. Explicit project replacement clears the source. Context/output changes retire old nodes and reupload only the retained current asset.

Cancellation of a transferred native upload closes only that endpoint. An old acknowledgement cannot overwrite a newer sample or restart a retired node. Latest UI rate edits remain authoritative when an older conversion finishes.

Synchronous Play guards capture the controller operation before a same-turn Stop; a pending UI Play enables local Stop and uses a gesture ticket. Stop, VGM start, Code stop, page disposal and output changes invalidate old pending UI completions.

Non-Abort transport failures retire only the matching endpoint/current operation, clear stale playing state, keep the sample and permit replay on a fresh node. Old RPC failures cannot retire a newer run. Disposal always releases nodes even if Stop fails.

VGM keeps its separate reference MSM decoder. The authored sample UI never claims to be a live view or extraction of a VGM stream. Existing exact HuC state/cache, VGM/manual interaction, paused audition, Capture and CDDA Code playback remain covered.

All108 readable modules and three device runtime pairs in the final189-file ZIP match the current source and their hash receipts. SDK0.1.8-huc-state/native/WASM/common runtime/Monaco and historical calibration reports were unchanged.

browsers.failureInjection: Actual native RAM transfer held/cancelled/late-released; actual first Worklet HTTP response held across local Stop; exactly one real MSM state request dropped until the existing20-second adapter timeout. No decoder or application command was replaced with fake PCM.

limitations: Current authored MSM selection, RAM and Rate/Loop defaults are session state; original files are persisted/exported in the project.
Rate/Loop changes apply at the next Play; replay starts at the requested beginning.
CDDA dedicated UI, VGM ADPCM material extraction, MSM pitched keyboard/wave drawing and a new preset format remain later work.
notPerformed: Human listening, real-game comparison and long-duration trial
SDK rebuild, Tauri import, npm/GitHub/itch publication, git staging or commit
